options.content:
### ExternalAuth Lifecycle Overview

Fleet-wide and per-resource view of ExternalAuth provisioning health.
Use the **Subscription** and **Resource ID** dropdowns above to drill into specific resources.

**User Journey**: `PUT ExternalAuth → Accepted → AwaitingSecret → Provisioning → Succeeded`

**SLO Targets** (PROPOSED — pending formal review via ARO-25935)
| SLI | Target | Metric |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Availability | 99% in Succeeded state | `backend_externalauth_provision_state` |
| Timeliness | 95% of creates < 15 min | `backend_resource_operation_*` |
| Error Rate | < 1% operations Failed | `backend_resource_operation_phase_info` |
| Degraded Health | 95% user-facing condition false | `backend_externalauth_condition_degraded` |
| Saturation | CPU < 85% of requests | `container_cpu_usage_seconds_total` |

**Runbook**: Pending publication via [ARO-25934](https://redhat.atlassian.net/browse/ARO-25934)

Degraded panels read `backend_externalauth_condition_degraded`, the user-facing Degraded condition. `condition="true"` is degraded and the value is 1. `condition="false"` is not degraded and the value is 0. `condition="unknown"` is also value 0 and is not counted as healthy. A resource with no series has no user-facing Degraded condition. `backend_externalauth_oidc_client_degraded` is not emitted. Those panels are not on this dashboard.

targets.expr: count(max without(prometheus_replica) (backend_externalauth_provision_state{subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Total ExternalAuths
panels.description: Total number of ExternalAuth resources across the fleet (or filtered by subscription/resource).

targets.expr: count by (phase)(max without(prometheus_replica) (backend_externalauth_provision_state{subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id"}))

panels.title: Provisioning State Distribution
panels.description: Distribution of ExternalAuth resources by provisioning state.

targets.expr: count(max without(prometheus_replica) ((time() - backend_resource_operation_start_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", operation_type="create", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", phase=~"accepted|provisioning"}) > 900)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Create >15m
panels.description: Number of ExternalAuth create operations running longer than 15 minutes. Excludes AwaitingSecret (customer-blocked waiting for OIDC client secret).

targets.expr: count(max without(prometheus_replica) ((time() - backend_resource_operation_start_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", operation_type="update", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", phase=~"accepted|updating"}) > 600)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Update >10m
panels.description: Number of ExternalAuth update operations running longer than 10 minutes (600 seconds). AwaitingSecret is excluded.

targets.expr: count(max without(prometheus_replica) ((time() - backend_resource_operation_start_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", operation_type="delete", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", phase="deleting"}) > 900)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Delete >15m
panels.description: Number of ExternalAuth delete operations running longer than 15 minutes. Only covers direct DELETE operations — ExternalAuths removed by parent cluster deletion do not create operations and are not tracked here.

targets.expr: count(max without(prometheus_replica) (backend_externalauth_provision_state{subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", phase="awaitingsecret"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: AwaitingSecret
panels.description: ExternalAuths waiting for the customer to create the OIDC client secret. These are customer-blocked and excluded from stuck/timeliness metrics.

targets.expr: count(max without(prometheus_replica) (backend_externalauth_condition_degraded{subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", condition="true"})) or (count(max without(prometheus_replica) (backend_externalauth_condition_degraded{subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", condition=~"true|false|unknown"})) * 0)

panels.title: Degraded ExternalAuths
panels.description: ExternalAuths whose user-facing Degraded condition is true. 0 means the condition gauge is present and none of the reported conditions are true. No condition series shows No data, not 0.

targets.expr: count(max without(prometheus_replica) (backend_externalauth_condition_degraded{subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", condition="false"}))

panels.title: Healthy ExternalAuths
panels.description: ExternalAuths whose user-facing Degraded condition is false. Unknown is not counted. No series shows No data: the condition is not set, and that is not a healthy count of zero.

targets.expr: count by (cluster) (max without(prometheus_replica) (backend_externalauth_condition_degraded{subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", condition="true"})) or (count by (cluster) (max without(prometheus_replica) (backend_externalauth_condition_degraded{subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", condition=~"true|false|unknown"})) * 0)

count by (cluster) (max without(prometheus_replica) (backend_externalauth_condition_degraded{subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", condition="false"}))

count by (cluster) (max without(prometheus_replica) (backend_externalauth_condition_degraded{subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", condition="unknown"}))

panels.title: User-facing Degraded Condition Over Time
panels.description: User-facing Degraded condition by cluster. true is degraded. false is not. unknown is not healthy. A true line at 0 means that cluster has a reported condition and none are true. A cluster with no condition series has no true line. false and unknown lines appear only when that status is set.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, cluster) (max without(prometheus_replica) (rate(frontend_http_requests_duration_seconds_bucket{route=~".*externalauths.*"}[5m]))))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, cluster) (max without(prometheus_replica) (rate(frontend_http_requests_duration_seconds_bucket{route=~".*externalauths.*"}[5m]))))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, cluster) (max without(prometheus_replica) (rate(frontend_http_requests_duration_seconds_bucket{route=~".*externalauths.*"}[5m]))))

panels.title: ExternalAuth Latency (p50 / p95 / p99)
panels.description: Frontend HTTP latency for ExternalAuth routes, from ARM request receipt to the synchronous response. Each line is one cluster. These percentiles are not averaged into a fleet percentile.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, code) (max without(prometheus_replica) (rate(frontend_http_requests_total{route=~".*externalauths.*", code=~"4.."}[5m])))
sum by (cluster, code) (max without(prometheus_replica) (rate(frontend_http_requests_total{route=~".*externalauths.*", code=~"5.."}[5m])))

panels.title: ExternalAuth Error Rate by Code
panels.description: Rate of 4xx and 5xx responses on ExternalAuth routes, one line per cluster and status code. 4xx is a rejected request. 5xx is a server error.

targets.expr: (max without(prometheus_replica) (time() - backend_resource_operation_start_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", phase=~"accepted|awaitingsecret|provisioning|updating|deleting"})) * on(resource_id, subscription_id, resource_type, operation_type, phase) group_left() (max without(prometheus_replica) (backend_resource_operation_phase_info{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", phase=~"accepted|awaitingsecret|provisioning|updating|deleting"}))

panels.title: Active Operations
panels.description: All currently in-flight ExternalAuth operations with their elapsed duration. Includes AwaitingSecret (customer-blocked). Color indicates severity: green (<5m), yellow (5-15m), red (>15m). Note: only shows direct CRUD operations — ExternalAuths removed by parent cluster deletion do not create operations.

targets.expr: max without(prometheus_replica) (time() - backend_resource_operation_start_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", phase=~"accepted|provisioning|updating|deleting"})

panels.title: In-Flight Operation Duration
panels.description: Real-time elapsed duration of each in-flight ExternalAuth operation. Excludes AwaitingSecret. Rising lines indicate stuck operations.

targets.expr: max without (prometheus_replica) (((backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", operation_type="create", phase="succeeded", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id"} - backend_resource_operation_start_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", operation_type="create", phase="succeeded", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id"}) / 60) and ((time() - backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", operation_type="create", phase="succeeded", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id"}) < $__range_s))

panels.title: Create Duration p50 (min)
panels.description: Median duration, in minutes, of successful ExternalAuth creates in the selected time range. Each successful create is one sample. Samples from every selected cluster are merged before the percentile. Internal subscriptions are excluded.

targets.expr: max without (prometheus_replica) (((backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", operation_type="create", phase="succeeded", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id"} - backend_resource_operation_start_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", operation_type="create", phase="succeeded", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id"}) / 60) and ((time() - backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", operation_type="create", phase="succeeded", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id"}) < $__range_s))

panels.title: Create Duration p95 (min)
panels.description: 95th percentile duration, in minutes, of successful ExternalAuth creates in the selected time range. Each successful create is one sample. Samples from every selected cluster are merged before the percentile. Internal subscriptions are excluded.

targets.expr: max without (prometheus_replica) (((backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", operation_type="create", phase="succeeded", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id"} - backend_resource_operation_start_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", operation_type="create", phase="succeeded", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id"}) / 60) and ((time() - backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", operation_type="create", phase="succeeded", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id"}) < $__range_s))

panels.title: Create Duration p99 (min)
panels.description: 99th percentile duration, in minutes, of successful ExternalAuth creates in the selected time range. Each successful create is one sample. Samples from every selected cluster are merged before the percentile. Internal subscriptions are excluded.

targets.expr: max(max without(prometheus_replica) (time() - backend_resource_operation_start_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", phase=~"accepted|provisioning|updating|deleting"}))

panels.title: Longest In-Flight Op
panels.description: Duration of the longest currently in-flight ExternalAuth operation. Excludes AwaitingSecret (customer-blocked).

targets.expr: count(max without(prometheus_replica) (backend_resource_operation_phase_info{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", phase=~"succeeded|failed|canceled"}))

panels.title: Retained Completed Ops
panels.description: Count of retained ExternalAuth snapshots in a terminal phase (succeeded, failed, or canceled). One series is kept per resource and operation type, and it is not guaranteed to be the latest operation. This is not a total of every operation in the 7-day Cosmos window. Note: update durations include both RP processing and HyperShift reconciliation time. Separating these requires hypershift_cluster_identity_providers from the HCPs workspace (not available in the services datasource).

targets.expr: (((count(max without(prometheus_replica) (backend_resource_operation_phase_info{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", phase="succeeded"}))) or vector(0)) and count(max without(prometheus_replica) (backend_resource_operation_phase_info{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", phase=~"succeeded|failed|canceled"}))) * 100

count(max without(prometheus_replica) (backend_resource_operation_phase_info{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", phase=~"succeeded|failed|canceled"}))

panels.title: Success Rate
panels.description: Percentage of retained terminal snapshots whose phase is succeeded. One series per resource and operation type, not a percentage of every completed operation. No retained terminal snapshots shows No data, not 0%.

targets.expr: max without(prometheus_replica) (backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", operation_type="create", phase=~"succeeded|failed|canceled"} - backend_resource_operation_start_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", operation_type="create", phase=~"succeeded|failed|canceled"})

max without(prometheus_replica) (backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", operation_type="update", phase=~"succeeded|failed|canceled"} - backend_resource_operation_start_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", operation_type="update", phase=~"succeeded|failed|canceled"})

max without(prometheus_replica) (backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", operation_type="delete", phase=~"succeeded|failed|canceled"} - backend_resource_operation_start_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", operation_type="delete", phase=~"succeeded|failed|canceled"})

panels.title: Operation Duration by Type (Completed)
panels.description: Retained duration of the latest completed create, update, and delete for each ExternalAuth. One line per resource. Internal subscriptions are excluded. This is the retained snapshot, not every completion inside the time range.

targets.expr: (((count(max without(prometheus_replica) (backend_externalauth_provision_state{subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", phase="succeeded"}))) or vector(0)) and count(max without(prometheus_replica) (backend_externalauth_provision_state{subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id"}))) * 100
count(max without(prometheus_replica) (backend_externalauth_provision_state{subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id"}))

panels.title: Provisioned Ratio
panels.description: Fleet percentage of ExternalAuth resources currently in Succeeded provisioning state. Succeeded and total counts are added across clusters before the division. This is provisioning state, not runtime degradation. No ExternalAuths shows No data, not 0%.

targets.expr: (((count(max without(prometheus_replica) (backend_externalauth_condition_degraded{subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", condition="false"})) or vector(0)) and count(max without(prometheus_replica) (backend_externalauth_condition_degraded{subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", condition=~"true|false|unknown"}))) * 100)

count(max without(prometheus_replica) (backend_externalauth_condition_degraded{subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", condition=~"true|false|unknown"}))

panels.title: True Availability (Non-Degraded)
panels.description: Percentage of reported user-facing Degraded conditions whose status is false. Unknown is in the denominator and is not treated as available. Resources with no user-facing Degraded condition are excluded. The panel shows No data when no condition is set, instead of 0%.

targets.expr: (((count(max without(prometheus_replica) ((backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", operation_type="create", phase="succeeded"} - backend_resource_operation_start_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", operation_type="create", phase="succeeded"}) < 900)) or vector(0))) and count(max without(prometheus_replica) ((backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", operation_type="create", phase="succeeded"} - backend_resource_operation_start_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", operation_type="create", phase="succeeded"})))) * 100

count(max without(prometheus_replica) ((backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", operation_type="create", phase="succeeded"} - backend_resource_operation_start_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", operation_type="create", phase="succeeded"})))

panels.title: Timeliness SLO (Create <15m)
panels.description: Percentage of successful ExternalAuth create operations that finished within 15 minutes. Failed/canceled operations are excluded — only successful creates count toward timeliness. No successful creates shows No data, not 0%.

targets.expr: (((count(max without(prometheus_replica) (backend_resource_operation_phase_info{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", phase="failed"})) or vector(0))) and count(max without(prometheus_replica) (backend_resource_operation_phase_info{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", phase=~"succeeded|failed|canceled"}))) * 100

count(max without(prometheus_replica) (backend_resource_operation_phase_info{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", phase=~"succeeded|failed|canceled"}))

panels.title: Operation Error Rate
panels.description: Percentage of retained terminal snapshots whose phase is failed. One series per resource and operation type, not a percentage of every completed operation. No retained terminal snapshots shows No data, not 0%.

targets.expr: count(max without(prometheus_replica) (backend_resource_operation_phase_info{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", phase=~"accepted|provisioning|updating|deleting"}))

panels.title: In-Flight Operations
panels.description: Number of ExternalAuth operations currently in non-terminal phases. Excludes AwaitingSecret (customer-blocked).

targets.expr: 100 * (count by (cluster) (max without(prometheus_replica) (backend_externalauth_provision_state{subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", phase="succeeded"})) / count by (cluster) (max without(prometheus_replica) (backend_externalauth_provision_state{subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id"})))

panels.title: Provisioned Ratio Over Time
panels.description: Succeeded ExternalAuths divided by all ExternalAuths, one line per cluster. The fleet percentage is the Provisioned Ratio stat, which adds the succeeded counts and the total counts across clusters before dividing. Dividing first and then averaging the lines would not be the fleet ratio.

targets.expr: count by (cluster) (max without(prometheus_replica) (backend_externalauth_provision_state{subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", phase="succeeded"}))

count by (cluster) (max without(prometheus_replica) (backend_externalauth_provision_state{subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", phase="failed"}))

count by (cluster) (max without(prometheus_replica) (backend_externalauth_provision_state{subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", phase=~"provisioning|accepted|updating|deleting"}))

count by (cluster) (max without(prometheus_replica) (backend_externalauth_provision_state{subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", phase="awaitingsecret"}))

panels.title: Provisioning State Over Time
panels.description: ExternalAuth count by provisioning state, one line per cluster. In Progress includes accepted, provisioning, updating, and deleting. AwaitingSecret stays separate.

targets.expr: count by (phase)(max without(prometheus_replica) (backend_cluster_provision_state{subscription_id=~"$subscription_id"}))

panels.title: Parent Cluster State Distribution
panels.description: Provisioning state of all HCP clusters in the selected subscription(s). Note: shows ALL clusters in the subscription, not just parents of the selected ExternalAuths.

targets.expr: max without(prometheus_replica) (backend_cluster_provision_state{subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", phase!="succeeded"})

panels.title: Clusters Not in Succeeded State
panels.description: All HCP clusters NOT in Succeeded state in the subscription. ExternalAuth operations on these clusters will fail or remain stuck. Note: subscription-wide, not filtered to ExternalAuth parents.

targets.expr: count by (operation_type)(max without(prometheus_replica) (backend_resource_operation_phase_info{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", phase="failed"}))

panels.title: Failed Operations by Type
panels.description: Count of failed ExternalAuth operations grouped by operation type (create/update/delete).

targets.expr: count by (subscription_id)(max without(prometheus_replica) (backend_resource_operation_phase_info{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", phase="failed"}))

panels.title: Failed Operations by Subscription
panels.description: Count of failed ExternalAuth operations grouped by subscription.

targets.expr: count by (subscription_id)(max without(prometheus_replica) (backend_externalauth_provision_state{subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", phase="failed"}))

panels.title: Failed ExternalAuths by Subscription
panels.description: Count of ExternalAuth resources currently in Failed provisioning state, grouped by subscription.

targets.expr: max without(prometheus_replica) (backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", phase="failed"} - backend_resource_operation_start_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", phase="failed"})

panels.title: Failed Operations Detail
panels.description: Detail table of all ExternalAuth operations in Failed state with their duration.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, method) (max without(prometheus_replica) (rate(frontend_http_requests_total{route=~".*externalauths.*"}[5m])))
sum by (cluster) (max without(prometheus_replica) (rate(frontend_http_requests_total{route=~".*externalauths.*"}[5m])))

panels.title: ExternalAuth Traffic Over Time (RPS)
panels.description: Request rate to ExternalAuth routes by HTTP method, plus the total for that cluster. This is the only request-rate chart on the dashboard.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (cluster) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="aro-hcp", container="aro-hcp-backend"}[5m])) / sum by (cluster) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{namespace="aro-hcp", container="aro-hcp-backend", resource="cpu"})

100 * sum by (cluster) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="aro-hcp", container="aro-hcp-backend"}) / sum by (cluster) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{namespace="aro-hcp", container="aro-hcp-backend", resource="memory"})

panels.title: Backend Saturation — CPU & Memory (SLO 85%)
panels.description: Backend pod CPU and memory as a percentage of requests, one line per cluster. The 85% line is the saturation threshold. The stat panels add usage and requests across clusters before dividing.

targets.expr: (sum(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="aro-hcp", container="aro-hcp-backend"}[5m]))) * 100
sum(kube_pod_container_resource_requests{namespace="aro-hcp", container="aro-hcp-backend", resource="cpu"})

panels.title: Saturation — CPU
panels.description: Current backend CPU utilization as percentage of requests.

targets.expr: (sum(container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="aro-hcp", container="aro-hcp-backend"})) * 100
sum(kube_pod_container_resource_requests{namespace="aro-hcp", container="aro-hcp-backend", resource="memory"})

panels.title: Saturation — Memory
panels.description: Current backend memory utilization as percentage of requests.

targets.expr: count(max without(prometheus_replica) (kube_pod_info{namespace="aro-hcp", pod=~"aro-hcp-backend.*"}))

panels.title: Backend Pods
panels.description: Number of running backend pods.

targets.expr: sum(max without(prometheus_replica) (rate(cosmos_request_units_total{namespace="aro-hcp", source_kind="controller", source=~"(?i)(externalauth.*|operationexternalauth.*)"}[5m])))

panels.title: ExternalAuth controller Cosmos RU/s
panels.description: Cosmos request units per second charged to ExternalAuth backend controllers, including OperationExternalAuthCreate, OperationExternalAuthUpdate, and OperationExternalAuthDelete. This is not the charge for every ExternalAuth document. Frontend and informer calls are not included.
